label: Hello
message: Hey! Thanks for reaching out. A staff member will be with you shortly — please describe your issue in as much detail as possible.

label: Issue Resolved
message: Hey! We're glad we could help. Your issue has been marked as resolved. If you have any further questions, feel free to open a new ticket.

label: Need More Info
message: Hey! We need a bit more information to help you. Could you please provide more details about your issue? (e.g. your in-game name, what happened, any screenshots)

label: Under Review
message: Hey! Your ticket is currently being reviewed by our team. We'll get back to you as soon as possible — thank you for your patience.

label: Escalated to Higher Staff
message: Hey! Your ticket has been escalated to a senior staff member who will be in touch shortly.

label: No Evidence / Insufficient Proof
message: Hey! Unfortunately we are unable to take action on this report without sufficient evidence. Please provide video or screenshot evidence and reopen a ticket.

label: Warning Issued
message: Hey! A warning has been issued regarding this matter. Please ensure you review the server rules to avoid further action.

label: Action Taken — Ban
message: Hey! After reviewing your report, appropriate action has been taken. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
